findings.consequence: NONE observed: a repository-wide grep finds no reader of rt['drift'] anywhere, so the loss was invisible because nothing consumed the value. The drift itself is already carried into the chain by invocation_started; this was a convenience copy.
findings.why_persisted_not_deleted: a convenience that silently evaporates is worse than one that does not exist, and the runtime block is where a reader would look. That nothing reads it today is stated in the code rather than implied by its presence.

limits: this sweep covers the rt[...] = form in experiments/live_ab/. It does not cover writes through an alias bound elsewhere, nor other helpers that may also return copies. _runtime is documented "never frozen, never hashed", so persisting a field into it changes no digest.
method: grep every assignment of the form rt[...] = across experiments/live_ab/, then read each site to see whether `rt` was bound to runtime(cfg) (a COPY) or to cfg.setdefault("_runtime", {}) (THE REAL BLOCK).
result: 2 copy-writes found; 1 already repaired, 1 repaired here; 0 remaining.
